card.name: Inside EMBRYO-FETAL in boxed warnings
card.fires_on: The letter O in the capitalized word EMBRYO before the hyphen in EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, in boxed warning headings. Also the V in AGGRAVATE in capitals.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O that ends EMBRY in the all-caps boxed warning title, just before -FETAL TOXICITY.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, INFUSION REACTIONS, EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY,

modes.label: AGGRAVATE in capitals
modes.description: The V partway through the capitalized word AGGRAVATE.
modes.example: INE, WHICH MAY FURTHER AGGRA<<V>>ATE DEHYDRATION AND ELECTRO

card.writes: Weak link to words like always and aggressively; the effect is unclear, with no clear theme.
card.plain: It fires inside the capitalized boxed-warning word EMBRYO in EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.
